method: Exact production app helper functions and production notebook wiring with minimal DOM adapters; actual Canvas map drawing; no browser layout/native-focus/WebGL claims.

checks.label: Atlas identity, 26 guides, 31 places and six regions remain intact
New data and exact production guide wiring provide sources, separate progress and reciprocal visits
All 20 new stops are selectable and explicit stop phases switch both model halves
Phase buttons clear incompatible stops, preserve shared observations and reject invalid modes
Direct links validate the stop, handle URI errors and preserve the atlas default
Initial historic deep link waits for coastal data and then switches phases without WebGL
Fallback Canvas retains every stop, cross-epoch hit targets and mobile model/panel insets
Only the maritime notebook offers the water-inspection control
Inspection hides water, restores it on close, stop change, phase change and leaving the visit
Without WebGL, inspection and near controls are disabled while phases, sources, tabs and maps remain usable
Guided coastal panels avoid legacy coastal CSS so the mobile fallback keeps its half-screen layout
Sources, thematic layers, keyboard tabs and completion remain independent between both visits
